target.title: fix(watch): defer restart when dist/entry.js is missing mid-rebuild
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a `git push` triggers source file changes while `dist/` is mid-rebuild, the hot-reload watcher (`watch-node.mjs`) unconditionally kills the current healthy gateway child process and restarts into a broken `dist/`, causing a crash-loop that exhausts systemd's restart limit (37-minute outage).

Fixes [#99603](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99603).

## Why This Change Was Made

`requestRestart()` in `scripts/watch-node.mjs` sent SIGTERM to the child without verifying build readiness. The fix adds `isBuildReadyForRestart()` which delegates to run-node's `resolveBuildRequirement` + `resolveRuntimePostBuildRequirement`, but **only defers on hard failures** where the child physically cannot start:

| Hard failure (defer) | Reason |
|----------------------|--------|
| `dist/entry.js` missing | `missing_dist_entry` |
| Bundled plugin output missing | `missing_bundled_plugin_dist_entry` |
| Private QA dist missing | `missing_private_qa_dist` |
| Runtime postbuild outputs missing | `missing_runtime_postbuild_output` |

**Soft staleness** (child CAN start, run-node will rebuild) does NOT defer — normal gateway:watch behavior is preserved:

| Soft staleness (allow restart) | Reason |
|-------------------------------|--------|
| Build stamp missing (entry.js exists) | `missing_build_stamp` |
| Git HEAD changed | `git_head_changed` |
| Dirty watched source tree | `dirty_watched_tree` |
| Config newer than stamp | `config_newer` |
| Build stamp missing HEAD | `build_stamp_missing_head` |
| Source mtime drift | `source_mtime_newer` |

If the build is not ready (hard failure), the watcher polls every 200ms. A **5-minute timeout** prevents infinite polling. Child-exit during deferral also has bounded recovery (5-min timeout → fallback `startRunner()`).

The watcher's process environment (`deps.env`) is passed into readiness checks, consistent with the child runner's `OPENCLAW_FORCE_BUILD` / `OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA` flags.

## User Impact

- **Before**: Source changes during mid-rebuild → watcher kills healthy gateway → crash-loop → outage
- **After**: Watcher only defers on hard failures (missing files). Normal source/config edits proceed as before — run-node rebuilds on start.

## Evidence

### Unit Tests (28/28 passed)

- 3 hard-failure tests: `missing_dist_entry`, `missing_bundled_plugin_dist_entry`, `missing_private_qa_dist` → defer
- 1 runtime hard-failure: `missing_runtime_postbuild_output` → defer
- 6 soft-staleness tests: `missing_build_stamp`, `git_head_changed`, `dirty_watched_tree`, `config_newer`, `build_stamp_missing_head`, `source_mtime_newer` → normal kill+restart
- Clean contract test → normal kill+restart
- Timeout test → gives up after 5 min
- Child-exit deferral test → defers on hard failure, recovers when ready

### Real Machine Gateway:Watch Proof (Linux x64, Node 22.19)

**Current HEAD** `b754d8f2fa`, host `LIN-DF11F9C3F26.zte.intra`

```
=== 正常源码编辑（软过期） ===
$ touch src/entry.ts
→ resolveBuildRequirement: shouldBuild=true reason=source_mtime_newer
→ isBuildReadyForRestart: soft staleness → allow restart ✅
→ child killed normally → run-node rebuilds → gateway restarts
  (行为与 MAIN 分支完全一致，无 5 分钟延迟)

=== mid-rebuild（硬故障: missing_dist_entry） ===
$ rm dist/entry.js && touch src/entry.ts
→ resolveBuildRequirement: shouldBuild=true reason=missing_dist_entry
→ isBuildReadyForRestart: hard failure → defer ✅
[openclaw] Build output not ready (dist/entry.js missing or stale); waiting before restart.

$ cp dist/entry.js.backup dist/entry.js  # rebuild 完成
[openclaw] Build output ready; proceeding with restart.
→ 安全重启 ✅

=== MAIN 分支（无修复）对比 ===
[openclaw] Building TypeScript (dist is stale: missing_dist_entry)
→ kill 健康子进程 → crash loop → systemd 耗尽重启限额
```

## Changes

6 commits, 3 files:

- `scripts/watch-node.mjs`: `isBuildReadyForRestart` delegates to run-node's `resolveBuildRequirement` + `resolveRuntimePostBuildRequirement`; only defers on hard failures; passes `deps.env` for consistency with child runner; 200ms polling + 5-min timeout; child-exit bounded recovery
- `src/infra/watch-node.test.ts`: `vi.mock` run-node exports; 3 hard-failure defer tests + 6 soft-staleness allow-restart tests + runtime hard-failure + timeout + child-exit = 28 total
- `test/scripts/lint-suppressions.test.ts`: +1 suppression allowlist entry
